oneOf.description:
Device-owned product switch projected to trusted central orchestrators.

The device is the only authority for this value. Central services may cache
the latest observed snapshot for routing and UI, but may never synthesize a
newer revision or treat their cache as desired state.

enabled.description: The one product-level AI Assistant switch. Defaults fail closed.

revision.description: Monotonic device-local revision. Revision zero is the initial state.

device_id.description:
Stable public target: the OSS client identity or Manager device UUID.
Browser connections have no device handle. This value grants no authority.

exec_capabilities.description: Effective host execution capabilities, independent of API version and authority.

owner_node_id.description:
Owning manager instance node id for cross-instance routing. Filled by the
manager; `None` on the OSS signal server (single instance, no
cross-instance routing).

peer.description: Public peer description. The authenticated boundary decides role and browser name.

debug_build.description: A reported debug marker; false is not proof of a release build.
